column1: # The parse of the object store address (the contract common/contracts/object-client.md parse; C10-OBJECT-ADDRESS-32). The form — README.

column4: file://<non-absolute path> — a start refusal, code 2
cluster:// — a write into its own directory <PLATFORM_DIR>/objects, the read of the cluster — the door resource
the part before «?» — the cluster name, not interpreted
another scheme — a start refusal, code 2
resource empty — a start refusal, code 2 (OBJECT135-URL-01)
resource repeated — a start refusal, code 2
resource after percent-decoding — to the transport as is
bare cluster:// — the resource door of its own server: url of the row platform/doors/<SERVER_NAME> (P03-OBJECTS-DEFAULT-1FD)
cluster://<name> without resource — as bare, the name is not interpreted
no door row — the read of the cluster «not known», not a start refusal
the door row does not read — «not known», not «no»
the store did not answer — «not known»
an explicit resource overrides the door row, it is not read
